item.title: Implement retry_budget.py per SPEC.md with focused tests
item.brief:
Operator request, verbatim: "Implement `retry_budget.py` according to `SPEC.md`. Preserve the documented API, handle every specified error and boundary case, and add focused tests. The existing tests cover basics only. Use the Python standard library and commit your work."

Read SPEC.md and the existing retry_budget.py and tests in the repository first. Implement every behaviour, error and boundary case the spec documents, keep the documented public API unchanged, and add focused tests covering each specified error and boundary case (not only the basics already tested). Use only the Python standard library. Keep functions under 60 lines, validate inputs at the boundary with clear errors, and never swallow failures. Run the test suite and make sure it passes before committing. Commit the work with a clear message; do not add any attribution lines beyond the ones the operator gave.

pr.body: Files: retry_budget.py (validation, _backoff, retry_delay), test_retry_budget.py (27 new tests covering validation, attempt limit, backoff saturation, Retry-After floor, budget boundaries). Validation raises ValueError for all invalid types and ranges, including non-int types, per SPEC. Backoff shift is bounded by cap bit length to avoid huge intermediates. Checks: unittest 30 OK; compile ok; line length ok. Review: independent reviewer pass, no findings. Assumptions: non-int types raise ValueError (spec says invalid values raise ValueError).
pr.summary: Implemented retry_delay, the pure bounded retry scheduler. Now validates all args, applies attempt limit, saturating backoff, Retry-After floor and strict budget check. Before: NotImplementedError. Now: 30 passing tests.
